sources.title: Gemma 4 12B: The Developer Guide - Google Developers Blog
sources.snippet: Meet Gemma 4 12B: the first medium-sized, encoder-free multimodal model capable of natively ingesting audio and video. Ideal for local AI development with 16GB VRAM, Hugging Face integrations, and drop-in local API servers.

sources.title: A Visual Guide to Gemma 4 12B | Krishnatheja Vanka
sources.snippet: Google DeepMind's Gemma 4 family originally shipped with a noticeable size gap: the E4B model on one end, and the much larger 26B A4B Mixture-of-Experts model on the other. Gemma 4 12B was released to sit neatly in that gap, targeting setups with roughly 12 to 16 GB of VRAM — a sweet spot for a lot of local and prosumer hardware.

sources.title: Gemma-3-12B — Doubleword | Multimodal Model by Google
sources.snippet: Gemma-3-12B: a lightweight, state-of-the-art multimodal model from Google featuring advanced reasoning, image understanding, and a massive 128K context window.
